description_en: Modifies a delivery channel for the current account
description_zh: 本接口用于当前账号修改投递渠道
name: UpdateConfigDeliveryChannel

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the delivery channel.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a delivery channel, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/429841.html
parameters.help_zh:
投递渠道ID。

关于如何获取投递渠道ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/429841.html
parameters.name: delivery_channel_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the delivery channel
parameters.name: delivery_channel_name

parameters.help_en:
The ARN of the destination to which the delivery channel delivers data. Valid values:

If the delivery channel is OSS, the format is `acs:oss:{RegionId}:{accountId}:{bucketName}`. Example: `acs:oss:cn-shanghai:100931896542****:new-bucket`.

If the delivery channel is Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS), the format is `acs:mns:{RegionId}:{accountId}:/topics/{topicName}`. Example: `acs:mns:cn-shanghai:100931896542****:/topics/topic1`.

If the delivery channel is Simple Log Service, the format is `acs:log:{RegionId}:{accountId}:project/{projectName}/logstore/{logstoreName}`. Example: `acs:log:cn-shanghai:100931896542****:project/project1/logstore/logstore1`
parameters.help_zh:
投递渠道目标地址的ARN。取值：

当投递渠道为OSS时，格式为`acs:oss:{RegionId}:{accountId}:{bucketName}`，例如：`acs:oss:cn-shanghai:100931896542****:new-bucket`。

当投递渠道为MNS时，格式为`acs:mns:{RegionId}:{accountId}:/topics/{topicName}`，例如：`acs:mns:cn-shanghai:100931896542****:/topics/topic1`。

当投递渠道为SLS时，格式为`acs:log:{RegionId}:{accountId}:project/{projectName}/logstore/{logstoreName}`，例如：`acs:log:cn-shanghai:100931896542****:project/project1/logstore/logstore1`
parameters.name: delivery_channel_target_arn

parameters.help_en:
The additional rules for the delivery channel. Currently, all deliveries to Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) and snapshot deliveries to Simple Log Service are supported.

If you specify the lowest risk level and resource types for events to which you subscribe in Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS), the rules are as follows:

The lowest risk level for events to which you subscribe is `{"filterType":"RuleRiskLevel","value":"1","multiple":false}`.

     
    `value` indicates the risk level that you want to filter. Valid values: 1 (high risk), 2 (medium risk), and 3 (low risk).

The resource types for events to which you subscribe are `{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`.
    
      
    `values` indicates the resource types of the events to which you want to subscribe. The value is a JSON array of resource types.
    Example:
`[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`

If you specify the resource types for snapshots to be delivered to Simple Log Service, the resource types are `{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`.
    
      
    `values` indicates the resource types of the snapshots that you want to deliver. The value is a JSON array of resource types.
    Example:
`[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`
parameters.help_zh:
投递渠道附加规则。当前支持MNS渠道的所有投递和SLS渠道的快照投递。

如果您指定MNS订阅事件的最低风险等级和资源类型，具体如下：

订阅事件的最低风险等级为`{"filterType":"RuleRiskLevel","value":"1","multiple":false}`。

     
    `value`表示您需要过滤的风险等级。取值：1表示高风险，2表示中风险，3表示低风险。

订阅事件的资源类型为`{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`。
    
      
    `values`表示您需要订阅事件的资源类型，是一个资源类型的JSON数组。
    例如：
`[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`

如果您指定SLS快照投递的资源类型，资源类型为`{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`。
    
      
    `values`表示您需要投递的资源类型，是一个资源类型的JSON数组。
    例如：
`[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`
parameters.name: delivery_channel_condition

parameters.help_en:
The ARN of the OSS bucket to which oversized data is transferred when the data size exceeds the limit of the delivery channel. The format is `acs:oss:{RegionId}:{accountId}:{bucketName}`.

If you do not specify this parameter, Cloud Config delivers only the summary information.

This parameter is supported only when the delivery channel is Simple Log Service or Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS). The delivery limit for Simple Log Service is 1 MB, and the delivery limit for Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) is 64 KB
parameters.help_zh:
当投递数据超过投递渠道限制时，投递数据转存到对象存储OSS的目标存储空间。格式为`acs:oss:{RegionId}:{accountId}:{bucketName}`。

如果您未设置该参数，配置审计仅投递概要信息。

仅支持投递渠道SLS和MNS。日志服务SLS的投递渠道限制是1 MB，轻量消息队列（原 MNS）的投递渠道限制是64 KB
parameters.name: oversized_data_oss_target_arn

parameters.help_en: The description of the delivery channel
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to receive scheduled resource snapshots. Cloud Config delivers scheduled resource snapshots to OSS or Simple Log Service at 04:00:00 and 16:00:00 (UTC) every day. Valid values:
true: Receive scheduled resource snapshots.
false: Do not receive scheduled resource snapshots. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否接收资源定时快照。每天`04:00Z`和`16:00Z`（UTC时间），配置审计定时向对象存储OSS或SLS投递资源定时快照。取值：
true：接收资源定时快照。
false（默认值）：不接收资源定时快照
parameters.name: configuration_snapshot

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to receive compliance snapshots. Cloud Config delivers resource compliance and non-compliance information to Simple Log Service. Valid values:
true: Receive compliance snapshots.
false: Do not receive compliance snapshots
parameters.help_zh:
是否接收合规快照。配置审计向日志服务SLS投递资源合规和不合规信息。取值：
true：接收合规快照。
false：不接收合规快照
parameters.name: compliant_snapshot

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to receive the configuration history of resources. When the configuration of a resource changes, Cloud Config delivers the configuration history to OSS, Simple Log Service, or Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS). Valid values:

true: Receive the configuration history of resources.
false: Do not receive the configuration history of resources. This is the default value.

This parameter is supported when the delivery channel is OSS, Simple Log Service, or Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS)
parameters.help_zh:
是否接收资源配置变更历史。当资源配置变更时，配置审计向对象存储OSS、日志服务SLS或轻量消息队列（原 MNS）投递资源配置变更历史。取值：

true：接收资源配置变更历史。
false（默认值）：不接收资源配置变更历史。

支持投递渠道OSS、SLS和MNS
parameters.name: configuration_item_change_notification

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to receive resource non-compliance events. When a resource is evaluated as non-compliant, Cloud Config delivers the non-compliance event to Simple Log Service or Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS). Valid values: 

true: Receive resource non-compliance events.
false: Do not receive resource non-compliance events. This is the default value.

This parameter is supported only when the delivery channel is Simple Log Service or Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS)
parameters.help_zh:
是否接收资源不合规事件。当资源不合规时，配置审计向日志服务SLS或轻量消息队列（原 MNS）投递资源不合规事件。取值： 

true：接收资源不合规事件。
false（默认值）：不接收资源不合规事件。

仅支持投递渠道SLS和MNS
parameters.name: non_compliant_notification

parameters.help_en:
The status of the delivery channel. Valid values:
0: disabled. Cloud Config retains the latest delivery configuration and stops delivering resource data.
1: enabled. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
投递渠道状态。取值：
0：关闭。配置审计保留最近一次投递配置，停止资源数据投递。
1（默认值）：开启
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The time of day when the delivery of scheduled resource snapshots starts.

The time must be in the `HH:mmZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC.

When you enable the delivery of scheduled resource snapshots, you can use this parameter to customize the delivery time. If you do not specify this parameter, the delivery starts at 04:00:00 and 16:00:00 (UTC) every day by default
parameters.help_zh:
资源定时快照每日开始投递的时间。

格式为`HH:mmZ`（UTC时间）。

当您开启资源定时快照投递时，可通过该参数自定义投递时间。如果您未设置该参数，则每天默认`04:00Z`和`16:00Z`开始投递
parameters.name: delivery_snapshot_time
